meta.title: Broker adds a supplier with a Tax ID

plan.title: Broker Adds Supplier by Tax ID

args.goal: From the logged-in Vendor/Supplier Dashboard, open the Profile menu, select Manage Suppliers, click Add Supplier, enter a full name, select a phone country code and enter the phone number, enter an email address, choose a business location from the searchable dropdown, enter the Tax ID field revealed for that location, click Done, and stop on the Suppliers List with the newly created supplier visible and the creation confirmation shown.

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated Vendor/Supplier Dashboard steps, so this performs the complete broker flow in the current session and proves the final screen state.
Verifies the required creation confirmation tooltip.
Verifies that the broker was redirected to the supplier list.
